texte:
Fish Taco Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1/2 mayonnaise
- 1/2 sour cream
- 1 lime
- 1 capers
- 1/2 ground cumin
- 1/2 dried oregano
- 1/2 dried dill weed
- 1/4 cayenne pepper

Instructions:
1. Blend mayo and sour cream (or yogurt) together; blend in lime juice, then capers, cumin, oregano, dill, and cayenne; it can be served immediately or can be made ahead.
2. I assemble my tacos by putting 1-2 fish fingers (depending on the size of tortilla), add a sprinkle of cabbage, a drizzle of sauce, then roll up.

nom: Pork Chops With Country Gravy and Mashed Potatoes
texte:
Pork Chops With Country Gravy and Mashed Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 3/4 salt
- 16 boneless center cut pork chops
- 1 butter
- 1 1/3 1% low-fat milk
- 3 all-purpose flour
- 1/4 poultry seasoning
- 1/4 black pepper
- 1 mashed potatoes

Instructions:
1. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Sprinkle 1/4 t salt over both sides of pork.
3. Add 1 teaspoon butter to pan, stirring until butter is melted.
4. Add the pork to pan, and cook pork for 3 minutes on each side.  Remove pork from pan, and keep warm.
5. Combine low-fat milk and flour, stirring with a whisk.
6. Add the milk mixture to pan, stirring with a whisk.
7. Stir in remaining 1/2 t salt, poultry seasoning, and black pepper.
8. Return pork to pan.  Cover; reduce heat, and simmer for 7 minutes or until gravy is thick and pork is done.
9. While pork cooks, prepare potatoes according to package directions.  Serve with pork.

Strawberry Cream Torte

Ingredients:
- 1/2 pecans
- 1 1/2 walnuts
- 2 flour
- 3/4 sugar
- 8 butter
- 1/2 cream cheese
- 1 sugar
- 3 fresh strawberries

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 325° degrees F.
2. Place nuts in a food processor and pulse until chopped fine; add flour and sugar; When well blended, add the cold butter, two tablespoons at a time; Remove from processor and spread in a spring form pan, pushing the mixture one inch up the sides of the pan.
3. Bake 30 to 40 minutes until golden; Remove from oven and cool.
4. Place cream cheese and sugar in a mixing bowl and beat on high speed until fluffy and well blended.
5. While the motor is still running, add small amounts of the whipping cream in a steady small stream into the cheese mixture, NOT TOO FAST, or the mixture will be too runny.
6. When well blended, spread the cream mixture evenly into the baked, cooled crust (At this point, it can be covered and chilled up to 24 hours.).
7. When ready to serve, place halved strawberries on top of the chilled cream mixture, remove the spring form pan rim, slice and serve.

Thum -- Garlic Sauce (Lebanon -- Middle East)

Ingredients:
- 5 garlic cloves
- 1/8 salt
- 1/3 extra virgin olive oil
- 4 yogurt
- 1 potato

Instructions:
1. In a mortar & pounding with a pestle, work the garlic cloves & a little salt until reduced to a very fine paste.
2. Drizzle in the oil very slowly, stirring constantly to blend well.
3. If you don't want the sauce to be as strong as this will be, add some yogurt and/or mashed potato & blend well before serving.

Puffed Apple Pancake

Ingredients:
- 1 milk
- 4 eggs
- 3 granulated sugar
- 1 vanilla
- 1/4 cinnamon
- 2/3 flour
- 4 butter
- 3 apples
- 3 brown sugar
- powdered sugar

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees Farenheit (or 420 for hotter ovens).
2. Whisk the milk, eggs, sugar, vanilla, and cinnamon in a large bowl.
3. Add the flour to the mixture and continue to whisk smooth.
4. Melt the butter in the microwave or oven and pour it into a 9x13-inch glass dish (it should be a couple of inches deep).
5. Place (and layer) the apple slices over the butter and bake in oven for 10 minutes.
6. Pour the batter over the apples and butter and sprinkle the brown sugar on top.
7. Bake for about 20 minutes or until it is puffy and spots on top are browning.
8. Remove from oven and let it cool slightly before serving. (it should be served hot: not piping hot, but warm).
9. Optional: Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving, or allow diners to sprinkle it on themselves at the table.

Streusel Topping

Ingredients:
- 3/4 sugar
- 3/4 flour
- 1 water
- 1 1/2 cinnamon
- 1/4 butter

Instructions:
1. mix all ingredients until crumbly -- .

Potatoes Lyonnaise

Ingredients:
- 3 potatoes
- 2 onions
- 2 margarine
- 2 garlic cloves
- 1/2 salt
- 1/8 pepper
- 1/8 paprika

Instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a deep, 3 quart micro-safe casserole dish.
2. Cover.
3. Cook on HIGH 9-11 minute or until potatoes and onions are tender, stirring every 5 minutes.
4. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

Ultimate Blueberry Coffee Cake

Ingredients:
- 3 unbleached white flour
- 1 sugar
- 4 baking powder
- 1 salt
- 1 cinnamon
- 3 eggs
- 2/3 canola oil
- 1 milk
- 3 frozen blueberries
- 1/3 sugar
- 1/2 flour
- 2/3 sugar
- 1 cinnamon
- 2 salt
- 8 canola oil

Instructions:
1. Mix first 5 dry ingredients together.
2. Add eggs, canola oil and milk.
3. By hand, mix together and do not overmix.
4. Fold in sugared blueberries.
5. Do not overmix and make sure they are frozen or it will turn your batter purple.
6. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 baking pan.
7. Mix ingredients for the strudel.  Studel topping will be thin.
8. Spoon over coffeecake.
9. Bake 375 degrees for 40 - 50 min or until knife inserted comes out clean.
10. Don't overbake.

Caesar Grilled Chicken

Ingredients:
- 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves
- 2/3 olive oil
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/4 lemon juice
- 1/4 parmesan cheese
- 1 salt
- 1/4 black pepper

Instructions:
1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. Place the chicken in a medium bowl.
3. In a blender, combine the remaining ingredients, Blend on high speed until mixture is smooth. Pour blended mixture over chicken, cover, and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours, or overnight.
4. Grill chicken 3 to 4 minutes per side, until no pink remains and the juices run clear.

Honey Roasted Squash Rings

Ingredients:
- 1/4 liquid honey
- 2 soy sauce
- 1 garlic
- 1/4 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 2 acorn squash

Instructions:
1. Whisk first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl.
2. Halve each squash crosswise, peel & scoop out seeds.
3. Cut into 1 inch thick rings & toss in honey mixture until well coated.
4. At this point, you can cover & refrigerate for up to 6 hours.
5. Arrange squash rings on a greased, foil lined, rimmed baking sheet & drizzle with honey mixture.
6. Bake in preheated 350F oven, turning once & basting with liquid, until tender & golden- about 30 to 40 minutes.

Pumpkin Cranberry Cookies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1/4 sugar
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 vanilla
- 2/3 pumpkin puree
- 3/4 dried cranberries
- 1 3/4 flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/8 salt
- 1 cinnamon
- 1/2 ginger
- 1/2 nutmeg
- 1/4 allspice
- 1/4 clove

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Cream together the butter and the sugars.
3. Beat in the egg, pumpkin and vanilla.
4. Mix dry ingredients together and then add to the wet ingredients and blend well.
5. Stir in dried cranberries.
6. Drop batter by rounded tablespoons onto a greased cookie sheet.
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

Shanna's Coffee Cake

Ingredients:
- 1/2 margarine
- 2 eggs
- 3 flour
- 1 milk
- 1 1/2 sugar
- 4 baking powder
- 1 salt
- 1 brown sugar
- 6 butter
- 1 cinnamon
- 4 flour

Instructions:
1. Mix all cake ingredients together.
2. Put 1/2 of the batter in a greased 9 x 13 pan.
3. Mix topping ingredients together, and sprinkle 1/2 on top of them over batter.
4. Dot the top with remaining batter and then sprinkle other 1/2 of topping mixture.
5. Bake 350° for 30 minutes or till golden brown.

Classic Easy Turkey Stuffing

Ingredients:
- 1/4 - 1/2 bacon
- 3/4 butter
- 3 celery
- 2 onions
- 2 garlic
- 14 poultry seasoning
- 2 rubbed sage
- 2 seasoning salt
- black pepper
- 1 low sodium chicken broth
- 1 1/4 dried cranberries

Instructions:
1. In a large frypan fry the bacon until crisp; (do not drain the drippings) remove and crumble; set aside.
2. Add 3/4 cup butter (no less than 3/4 cup!) to the bacon drippings and melt.
3. Add in chopped celery, onions and garlic; sauté until tender.
4. Add HALF of the bread cubes to the butter; stir to coat, and keep stirring with a wooden spoon until the bread cubes are lightly browned and the butter is absorbed.
5. Transfer to a large bowl (or finish in the frypan, if you have a large enough frypan to hold all ingredients) and add in remaining bread cubes, salt, pepper and poultry seasoning or sage (if using).
6. Add in crumbled bacon and the cranberries or other ingredients that you choose to use; mix to combine.
7. Drizzle with the chicken broth (mixing with a wooden spoon) until you have reached the desired moistness, you might have to add in more than 1 cup, but do not add in too much or your bread will become too \"soggy\".
8. Immediately stuff the turkey, and cook.
9. **NOTE** the flavor of the stuffing will vary depending on ingredients and type of bread used.

nom: Chip Crumbles - Very Quick and Easy!
texte:
Chip Crumbles - Very Quick and Easy!

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 1 firm margarine
- 1 brown sugar
- 2 vanilla
- 1 all-purpose flour
- 1 walnuts

Instructions:
1. Crumble butter, brown sugar, vanilla and flour in a bowl.
2. Stir in walnuts (optional) and chocolate chips.
3. Press into an ungreased 9x9 pan.
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes.
5. Cut while warm.  Cool.
6. Enjoy!

An Elbow in the Boobs

Ingredients:
- 1 white rum
- 1/2 Cointreau liqueur
- 1/2 dry vermouth
- 1/2 sweet vermouth
- 1/2 lemon juice
- 1 maraschino cherry

Instructions:
1. Add rum,cointreau,vermouths and lemon juice to a cocktail shaker. Shake thoroughly and pour in to a 3 oz cocktail glass garnish with a marachino cherry and serve.

Rosemary-Asiago Muffins (Low Fat)

Ingredients:
- 2 1/2 cake flour
- 1 sugar
- 2 baking powder
- 3/4 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 2 fresh rosemary leaves
- 3 extra virgin olive oil
- 1 1/2 nonfat plain yogurt
- 1/2 asiago cheese

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400-degrees  F.
2. Spray a 12 cup muffin tin with cooking spray.
3. Sift the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt into  a large bowl.
4. Stir in the rosemary.
5. Add the oil and stir until blended.  Gently stir in the yogurt and 1/4 cup of the cheese,  just until blended, about 20 strokes.
6. Spoon the batter into the muffin cups.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
7. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until  a wooden pick inserted into the center comes out clean. Remove from the muffin tin and serve immediately.

Sweet Rice With Cinnamon (Roz Mafooar)

Ingredients:
- 1 1/3 rice
- 2 2/3 water
- 1/2 salt
- 1/4 butter
- 1/4 powdered sugar
- ground cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Heat rice, water, and salt to boiling, stirring once or twice.
2. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 14 minutes. Remove from heat.
3. Fluff rice lightly with fork, then cover and let steam 5-10 minutes.
4. Stir in butter and powdered sugar.
5. Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve warm.

Best Cheese Bread

Ingredients:
- 3 3/4 all-purpose flour
- 2 1/2 cheddar cheese
- 5 baking powder
- 1/2 garlic powder
- 1/2 dill weed
- 2 eggs
- 1 1/2 milk
- 1/3 canola oil
- 3 honey

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F, then grease a 9\"x5\" loaf pan.
2. In a large bowl combine flour, cheese, baking powder, garlic powder & dill.
3. In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, oil & honey, then stir this mixture into the flour mixture until just moistened.
4. Pour into the prepared loaf pan & bake 55-65 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
5. Cool in the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes before removing the loaf from the pan to cool slightly (upright) on the wire rack.
6. Serve warm & enjoy! Store any leftovers in the refrigerator.

Grandpa's Hungarian Kolacky

Ingredients:
- 1 butter
- 2 margarine
- 2 cream cheese
- all-purpose flour
- powdered sugar

Instructions:
1. Combine butter and cream cheese completely, add flour and mix well.
2. Divide dough into 4 balls; wrap each in plastic wrap and chill 24 hours.
3. Roll out each ball (on floured surface) to 1/8\". (Be sure to keep them thin, as this keeps them \"light!\")
4. Cut out silver-dollar sized cookies; place on ungreased cookie sheets.
5. Drop 1/2 teaspoon jelly in center of each cookie and bake at 350* for 7-8 min. (Just until edges begin to brown.) I always bake the cookies flat; however, the edges may be pinched or rolled together as well!
6. Lightly sift powdered sugar over cookies and serve.

Coconut Snowball Martini

Ingredients:
- 3/4 half-and-half
- 1/2 rum
- 1/4 vanilla vodka
- 1/4 vodka
- cream of coconut

Instructions:
1. In a pitcher stir together the half-and-half, coconut rum, vanilla vodka, and cream of coconut.
2. Place ice cubes in a martini shaker.
3. Add coconut mixture.
4. Cover and shake.
5. Divide mixture among prepared martini glasses.
6. Makes: 4 to 6 drinks.

Zucchini Marinata (Marinated Zucchini Salad)

Ingredients:
- 1 zucchini
- 1 garlic cloves
- 2 extra virgin olive oil
- 1 -2 salt
- fresh ground black pepper
- fresh basil
- 2 -3 fresh parsley

Instructions:
1. Note: It is your choice to peel or not peel the zuchhini.
2. Toss the thinly sliced zucchini with the lemon juice, garlic halves, olive oil; salt and pepper to taste. (If I think about it, sometimes I add a bit of finely grated lemon zest, too.) Remember to use a non-reactive bowl for marinating.
3. Cover bowl and refrigerate 4-8 hours, stirring occasionally.
4. Once you are ready to serve the salad, remove the garlic cloves. Save one garlic clove, finely minced and toss back into the salad along with the fresh herb of choice. *Important*: stir in the fresh herbs with the zucchini mixture [just] before serving.
5. Adjust seasoning if necessary.
6. Best eaten within 24 hours.

nom: Super Easy Triple Layer Lemon Pie
texte:
Super Easy Triple Layer Lemon Pie

Ingredients:
- 2 milk
- 2 instant lemon pudding
- 6 graham cracker pie crusts
- 1 non-dairy whipped topping

Instructions:
1. Pour milk into large bowl.  Add dry pudding mixes.  Beat with wire wisk 2 minutes or until well blended (mixture will be thick).
2. Spread 1.5 cups of the pudding onto the bottom of the crust.
3. Gently stir half of the whipped topping into remaining pudding in bowl and spread over pudding layer in crust.
4. Top with remaining whipped topping.
5. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.  Garnish with lemon peel, if desired.  Store leftover pie in refrigerator.

nom: Chicken Pasta With Sour Cream and Cheese Sauce (Zwt3 Western)
texte:
Chicken Pasta With Sour Cream and Cheese Sauce (Zwt3 Western)

Ingredients:
- 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts
- 1/4 white wine
- 1 white pepper
- 1/2 bacon
- 1/2 mushroom
- 4 garlic
- 1 butter
- 1 fettuccine pasta
- 1 sour cream
- 1/2 butter
- 3/4 monterey jack cheese
- 1/2 white wine
- 1/2 parmesan cheese
- 1/4 mozzarella cheese
- parsley

Instructions:
1. Poach the chicken in white wine, uncovered, seasoned with a dash of white pepper, about 10 minutes.  Cut into small pieces and set aside.
2. Fry bacon bits till crisp. Remove from skillet and drain on a peper towel.  Set aside.
3. Over medium heat saute the mushrooms and garlic in butter for about 5 minutes.
4. Combine chicken, bacon and mushroom garlic mixture and keep warm.
5. Prepare and drain fettucine, tossing with a light coating of olive oil if desired.
6. Sauce:
7. Combine all sauce ingredients except parsley in a saucepan.  Over low heat, mix till cheese is melted and sauce becomes smooth.
8. Pour the sauce over the noodles and mix together well.
9. Top with chicken, bacon and mushroom mixture.
10. Garnish with chopped parsley.

Scandinavian Chicken Soup

Ingredients:
- 4 whole chickens
- 6 chicken broth
- 1 potato
- 1 onion
- 1 fresh dill weed
- 1 salt
- 1/4 pepper
- 1/2 red onion
- 1/2 fresh dill weed

Instructions:
1. Cook chicken in a kettle until done. Cool, debone, and chop into pieces.
2. Strain the cooking liquid and return chicken broth to a boil over high heat.
3. Add diced potatoes, onion, and dillweed. After the soup returns to a boil, reduce the temperature and simmer the potatoes until tender, about 12 minutes.
4. Add the chicken, salt, and pepper; simmer about 5 minutes.
5. Sprinkle with chopped red onions and dillweed just before serving.

Utah's Famous Pink Sauce

Ingredients:
- 1 mayonnaise
- 1 ketchup

Instructions:
1. Stir together until well blended.
2. Store in fridge.

Blonde Brownies

Ingredients:
- 1/2 butter
- 1 1/2 brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 1 vanilla
- 1 1/2 flour
- 1/2 baking powder
- 1/2 salt
- 1 white chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Melt butter and then gently sitr until just mixed all ingredients except chips.  Do not beat the mixture.
2. Add chips.
3. Place into greased 13 x 9  baking pan.
4. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
5. Cool and cut into bars.

nom: Sour Cream Cake With Chocolate Chips
texte:
Sour Cream Cake With Chocolate Chips

Ingredients:
- 2 all-purpose flour
- 2 sugar
- 2 baking powder
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/2 salt
- 1 1/3 sour cream
- 2/3 butter
- 1 margarine
- 3 vanilla
- 1 eggs
- 1 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Coat a 9 X 13 inch pan with cooking spray.
3. In a large bowl, combine flour, 1 1/2 cups sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, sour cream, butter, vanilla and eggs. Blend at low speed of electric mixer for 3 minutes.
4. Pour one-half of the batter into prepared pan. Combine the remaining 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle one-half of sugar mixture and one-half chocolate chips over batter. Repeat with remaining batter, sugar mixture and chocolate chips.
5. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until a wooden toothpick comes out clean. Remove from oven and cool on wire rack.

Honey Hair Softener

Ingredients:
- 1/2 honey
- 1 olive oil
- 1 lemon juice

Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Lather into wet hair and cover with bag or shower cap.
3. Leave on for 30 minutes and shampoo as usual.

Berry Smoothie

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 2% low-fat milk
- 8 frozen strawberries
- 6 frozen raspberries
- 6 frozen blueberries

Instructions:
1. put all of the berries into a blender and then add the milk.
2. blend for 10-15 seconds.
3. then pour into a cup.

Amarula Delight

Ingredients:
- 2 Amarula cream liqueur
- 2 milk
- 2 half-and-half
- 2 vanilla ice cream

Instructions:
1. Mix the Amarula, milk, and coke in glass of choice then add the ice cream(allow room for it to fizz up some.

Veggie and Black Bean Wrap

Ingredients:
- 4 fat free tortillas
- 2 fresh mushrooms
- 1 onion
- 1 black beans
- 4 fresh spinach leaves
- 1/2 reduced-fat cheddar cheese

Instructions:
1. Heat tortillas as directed on package. While tortillas are heating, spray 10-inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat.
2. Cook mushrooms and onion in skillet about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until onion is crisp-tender. Stir in beans and heat through. Stir in spinach. The heat will wilt the spinach leaves. Remove from heat.
3. Divide bean mixture among tortillas. Sprinkle with cheese. Fold one end of each tortilla up about 1 inch over filling and fold right and left sides over folded end, overlapping. Fold remaining end down.
4. Enjoy.

Anyday Louisiana Biscuits

Ingredients:
- 1 flour
- 1 1/2 baking powder
- 1/8 baking soda
- 1/8 salt
- 2 light margarine
- 1/2 nonfat plain yogurt
- 1 honey

Instructions:
1. Mix first four ingredients in large bowl.
2. Using a pastry blender or fork, cut in the margarine until the mix resembles coarse meal.
3. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
4. Add yogurt and honey until dry ingredients are just moistened.
5. Knead the dough 4 times on a floured surface.  Roll the dough into 1/2\" thickness and cut off biscuit rounds about 2 1/2\" wide.
6. Place each biscuit on an ungreased baking sheet (I like air bake sheets).
7. Bake at 425 degrees F for 10 minutes or until golden.  Serve hot and fresh!

Scallion Bread Appetizers

Ingredients:
- 1 French baguette
- 5 scallions
- 16 cheddar cheese
- 1/2 mayonnaise

Instructions:
1. Slice baguette into 1/4\" slices.
2. Chop scallions into bits and mix with shredded cheddar.
3. Add enough mayonnaise to make of spreading consistency.
4. Spread mixture onto breads and put on cookie sheet.
5. Bake on 425 degrees until bubbly and/or very lightly browned.

Green Beans Prapice

Ingredients:
- 1 green beans
- 4 butter
- 3/4 onion
- 1 sweet Hungarian paprika
- 2 flour
- 1 sour cream
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Add the beans to a pot of boiling salted water, reduce the heat to medium and cook uncovered 10-15 minutes or until just tender, drain.
2. Melt butter in a large skillet, add the onions and cook 4-5 minutes or until they are translucent.
3. Remove pan from heat, add paprika and stir until onions are well coated.
4. In a small bowl, wire whisk the flour into the sour cream, add to the onions, add salt and mix.
5. Return the skillet to the stove and simmer on low heat 4-5 minutes or until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
6. Gently stir in the beans and simmer 5 minutes.

Ham'n Cheese Picnic Bread

Ingredients:
- 3 all-purpose flour
- 1 active dry yeast
- 1 water
- 1 egg
- 1 butter
- 1 sugar
- 1 salt
- 1 ham
- 1 mozzarella cheese
- 1 pimento pepper
- 1/2 black olives

Instructions:
1. In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water and let stand until fully dissolved and creamy (this will take close to 10 minutes).
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the dissolved yeast mixture, with the flour, butter, egg, sugar and salt and mix this well.
3. When the dough has come (pulled) together, turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until nice and smooth.
4. This will take around 7-8 minutes.
5. Lightly oil a large mixing bowl, place the dough in this bowl and turn to coat the dough with oil.
6. Cover with a damp cloth and set aside to rise in a warm place until it has doubled in volume.
7. This will take approximately 1 hour.
8. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
9. Combine ham, cheese, pimento, and olives in a medium bowl, and set aside.
10. Deflate the dough and turn it out onto a lightly floured surface.
11. ROll or pat the dough into a 10x14 inch rectangle.
12. Make parallel cuts 3/4 inch wide and 2 inches long on the two long edges of the rectangle.
13. Evenly spread the filling mixture over the center of the rectangle.
14. Fold the short ends of the rectangle over the filling.
15. Starting from one of these ends-- alternately stretch strips so that they overlap diagnally.
16. Transfer the loaf to a lightly greased baking sheet, cover with damp cloth and set aside to rise until doubled in volume.
17. This will take around 40 minutes or so.
18. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Curried Pecans

Ingredients:
- 2 pecans
- 1 1/2 butter
- 1 curry powder
- 1/2 salt

Instructions:
1. Put pecans and butter into a 9\" x 9' pan.
2. Heat in 350F degrees oven until butter melts.
3. Stir well to coat nuts.
4. Continue to roast, stirring every 2-3 minutes  for about 15 minutes, they can burn if you arent careful!
5. Remove from oven.
6. Transfer to paper towels so grease will be absorbed a bit then put nuts into bowl.
7. Sprinkle with curry powder and salt if desired.
8. Stir to mix thoroughly.

Creamy Tomato-Cucumber Salad

Ingredients:
- 2 cucumbers
- 2 plum tomatoes
- 1 red onion
- 1 1/2 sour cream
- 2 sugar
- 1 1/2 - 2 white vinegar
- 1/2 dried dill
- 1/2 garlic powder

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine cucumber, chopped tomato and onion; toss to combine.
2. In another bowl combine sour cream, sugar, vinegar, dill and garlic powder (if using) mix well then pour over veggies, and toss to coat.
3. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Cover and chill until serving.

nom: Mrs. Field's Soft and Chewy Peanut Butter Cookies
texte:
Mrs. Field's Soft and Chewy Peanut Butter Cookies

Ingredients:
- 2 flour
- 1/2 baking soda
- 1/4 salt
- 1 1/4 dark brown sugar
- 1 1/4 granulated sugar
- 1 butter
- 3 eggs
- 1 creamy peanut butter
- 2 vanilla extract

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees F.
2. Mix dry ingredients and set aside.
3. On medium speed, in large bowl, blend sugars; add butter, mix till grainy consistency. Add eggs, peanut butter and vanilla extract; beat till fluffy. On low speed, add flour mixture until barely mixed into butter mixture.
4. Drop by rounded tablespoonsful, 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Use a wet or flour coated fork to gently press a crisscross pattern on top of each cookie.
5. Bake until the edges of the cookies are lightly browned, approximately 18 to 20 minutes. Remove to cool on a flat surface.

Absolute Best Ovenight Baked Oatmeal

Ingredients:
- 2 oatmeal
- 1 skim milk
- 1/4 milk
- 1/4 brown sugar
- 1/2 maple syrup
- 1/4 pecans
- 2 golden raisin
- 1 1/2 eggs
- 1/4 baking powder
- 1/4 nutmeg
- 1/4 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Dump all ingredients in an 8 x 8 casserole dish or pie pan; stir well; cover and put in the refrigerator overnight.
2. In the morning, preheat the oven to 425 degrees and bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top starts to brown; serve hot, with milk over it if desired.

Peaches and Plums

Ingredients:
- 4 black plums
- 3 nectarines
- 1/2 brown sugar
- 1/3 flour
- 1/4 margarine
- 3/4 oats
- 1/4 cinnamon

Instructions:
1. Lightly grease a shallow 2 quart baking dish.
2. Mix plums and nectarines, spread in dish.
3. Mix sugar and flour, cut in margarine with pastry blender.
4. Stir in oats.
5. Sprinkle mixture evenly over fruit.
6. Dust with cinnamon.
7. Bake at 350 30-35 minutes.
8. Serve warm.
